guard: traffic retained while the asynchronous focus frontier is captured is excluded from recall without depending on a fixed microtask count
why: setAttention(focus) now awaits the connectedness gate before it opens enteringFocus, so one
blind Promise.resolve no longer reaches the transition window. The smoke must wait on the real
flag, boundedly, before injecting the retained message. Separate mutants remove the ingest-side
exclusion and recall-side filter so the fixed scheduling cannot mask a broken implementation.

mutations.name: ingest no longer records messages arriving during focus entry
mutations.expectRed: focus-entry normal buffer is excluded from recall
mutations.cell: focus-entry normal buffer is excluded from recall

mutations.name: recall no longer filters ids retained during focus entry
mutations.expectRed: focus-entry normal buffer is excluded from recall
mutations.cell: focus-entry normal buffer is excluded from recall

mutations.name: the smoke returns to one blind microtask yield
mutations.replace:
await Promise.resolve();
    check(`focus-entry ${quiet ? "quiet" : "normal"} transition window opened before the retain emit`, (a2 as unknown as { enteringFocus: boolean }).enteringFocus);
mutations.expectRed: focus-entry normal transition window opened before the retain emit
mutations.cell: focus-entry normal transition window opened before the retain emit
